name: Fractera Auth
shortDescription: The single service that hands out entry: sessions, roles, sign-in forms in 82 languages.
longDescription: The node's sign-in service: accounts, sessions and roles in its own SQLite database, the sign-in, registration and guest forms in 82 languages, single sign-on for elements on their own domains (a one-time code exchanged for a ticket) and the user list for the architect. Every element of the node asks it who came; no other element signs people in.
accepts: A browser session cookie or a sign-in ticket; e-mail and password, Google, a guest request, the architect token.
returns: The session (user, e-mail, roles) or 401; sign-in forms; tickets and one-time codes for single sign-on.
